queries.role: Open Loop Agent: which saved intentions share entities
queries.sql: SELECT l.title, COUNT(DISTINCT le.entity_id) FROM recall_data.app.open_loops l JOIN recall_data.app.loop_entities le ON l.loop_id = le.loop_id WHERE l.status IN ('OPEN','ACTIVE') GROUP BY l.title ORDER BY 2 DESC
queries.note: Active intentions and how many entities each ties together.

queries.role: Open Loop Agent: Evidence per entity (related-evidence retrieval)
queries.sql: SELECT en.name, COUNT(DISTINCT ee.evidence_id) FROM recall_data.app.entities en JOIN recall_data.app.evidence_entities ee ON en.entity_id = ee.entity_id GROUP BY en.name ORDER BY 2 DESC
queries.note: The join behind get_related_evidence: screenshots that mention the same entity.

queries.role: Evidence Agent output: non-sensitive Evidence by domain
queries.sql: SELECT domain, COUNT(*) FROM recall_data.app.evidence WHERE sensitive = false GROUP BY domain ORDER BY 2 DESC
queries.note: Sensitive Evidence is stored but excluded from every reasoning query.

role: Zetaris is the system of record: append-only Evidence, entities, links, Open Loops, Check-ins. The agents retrieve through it; without it they have no memory of what was saved.
